content.short: Yuzu Money provides institutional tokenized RWA and DeFi yield infrastructure on Monad.
content.description: Yuzu Money runs tokenized real-world asset and DeFi yield products as several distinct product lines, not a single pooled vault. Alpha and Prime are its two main strategies, with reserves and liabilities attested on-chain, alongside a curated Marketplace of third-party vaults whose sizes are read live from a public API. Individual products include yzUSD, yzSyrup, yzCash and yzmGLOBAL, each with its own mandate. The platform is aimed at institutional allocators and packages the whole thing as yield-as-a-service.
content.meta: Tokenized RWA and DeFi yield kept in separate product lines for compliance reasons.
